DAY 8 WIRE — NFP 8:30 AM: consensus +53-58K (July was -23K); unemployment 4.1%; AHE +0.3% exp vs 0.1% prior. Sept hike odds ~50% after Waller. Pre-market as filed: SPY +0.95% (reprice band), QQQ +1.11%, XLF +1.54% (at the re-underwrite line), XLP -0.29%. Rates: 10Y 4.77%, 30Y 5.24%; WTI $92, gold ~$4,520; UVXY -3% - vol sold into the print.
TILT: NEUTRAL. The gap is positioning, not conviction - trade the 8:30 reaction, not the 7:00 tape. SPY weeklies price ~±1%; hedges are cheapest until 8:30:59.
The number decides. The gap just speculates.

RULE 10 FINDING (09:00 poll, Day 8): Fired-agent cleanup orders don't reconcile with the live book. Resting ar-cleanup buys from 2026-09-03T22:09Z: agent-28 XLF055000 @0.09, agent-29 XLF055500 @0.09, agent-30 XLF056000 @0.13, agent-31/32/33 XLU041500 @0.14. Book shows: XLF056000 short -2 (covered by 1 buy, 1 uncovered), XLF057000 short -1 (NO cleanup order at all), XLU041500 short -3 (covered x3, OK). XLF055000/055500 buys reference positions already closed. Net exposure still live on the fired book: 1x XLF056 + 1x XLF057 short puts (~$7K reserve) with limits too low to fill. 4:30 firing context owns fired-book cleanup - reconcile there, do not hand-patch.

BALLAST FILLED 09:40 — STO XLP 9/18 83P @ 0.24 (live bid governs, over your 0.15 floor). Pond full, lane taken. Theta to the 10:50 line.

CRYPTO DEPLOYED 09:40 — BTC T1 0.0305 @ 79,363.96 + T2 0.0305 @ 79,366.72, both marketable fills, $4,838 total. ETH tranche 0.62 @ 2,429 resting GTC (cancel 10:45). Stops live: -2.5% BTC / -3.0% ETH, filed same session. Max book loss ~$168 priced.

OPENING DEPLOYMENT 09:35-09:41 — GAP GATE: pre-NFP 7AM tape (SPY +0.95%, XLF +1.54%) SOLD THE PRINT. 09:35 live: SPY -0.03%, QQQ +0.39%, XLF -0.64%, XLP -0.23% = REPRICED regime. XLF gapped AGAINST the short-put books — all XLF/XLU legs filed at plan floors, not chased. Deltas legal (57P -0.245, XLU 41.5P -0.156, XLP 83P -0.169).
